answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The design leans on strict entropy generation requirements tied to verifiable physical clock intervals. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the karst of a task receipt, and the yarrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
